rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken equivalent when “actually” corrects or contrasts a claim.

example.english: Actually, I don't like spicy food.
example.jyutping: kei4 sat6 ngo5 m4 zung1 ji3 sik6 laat6

rows.note: Use this when “actually” means “really” and adds emphasis rather than simply correcting the listener.

example.jyutping: zan1 hai6 gam1 jat6 jit6 dou3 deng2 m4 seon6

rows.note: Use this for “actually” meaning “currently” or “at the moment,” not for emphasis or correction.

example.english: I'm actually in a meeting at the office right now.
example.jyutping: ji4 gaa1 ngo5 hai2 gung1 si1 hoi1 gan2 wui2
